papers.title: Neuronal FICD shapes motivated behavior through modulation of dopamine receptor dynamics
papers.translated_title: 神经元FICD通过调节多巴胺受体动力学塑造动机行为
papers.author: Weaver, K. J.
papers.summary: Motivated behaviors rely on dopaminergic signaling, which in turn depends on the correct folding and trafficking of receptors through the endoplasmic reticulum (ER). Within the ER, the AMPylase enzyme FICD acts as a molecular rheostat through its modification of the chaperone BiP, dynamically tuning the organelle's responsiveness to folding perturbations and cellular stress. While the biochemistry of FICD is well-established, its role in complex animal behavior remains poorly understood. Here, we identify FICD as a conserved contributor to the generation of motivated behavior. In Drosophila, pan-neuronal knockdown of dFic significantly reduces feeding, spontaneous locomotion, and reward-seeking behavior. These alterations occur without disrupting circadian architecture, motor capacity, or homeostatic hunger, indicating a specific loss of motivational drive. Depleting dFic within subsets of dopamine receptor-expressing (Dop1R1) neurons recapitulates these behavioral alterations. Transcriptomic profiling reveals that dFic depletion does not induce a canonical unfolded protein response, pointing to a specific post-transcriptional alteration rather than global ER stress. At the molecular level, dysregulated dFic alters the localization and abundance of Dop1R1. Finally, we demonstrate that this regulatory axis is evolutionarily conserved, as loss of FICD similarly diminishes motivated behaviors in C. elegans and mice. Together, these findings implicate FICD in the generation of motivated behavior and link dynamic control of ER proteostasis to dopamine-receptor maturation.
papers.translated_summary: 动机行为依赖于多巴胺能信号传导，而后者又取决于受体在内质网中的正确折叠和运输。在内质网中，AMPylase酶FICD通过修饰分子伴侣BiP充当分子变阻器，动态调节该细胞器对折叠扰动和细胞应激的响应能力。虽然FICD的生物化学特性已被充分确立，但其在复杂动物行为中的作用仍知之甚少。在此，我们确定FICD是动机行为产生的一个保守贡献者。在果蝇中，泛神经元敲低dFic显著减少了摄食、自发运动和奖赏寻求行为。这些改变的发生并未破坏昼夜节律结构、运动能力或稳态饥饿，表明动机驱力的特异性丧失。在多巴胺受体表达（Dop1R1）神经元亚群中耗竭dFic可重现这些行为改变。转录组分析显示，dFic耗竭并不诱导经典未折叠蛋白反应，指向特定的转录后改变而非全局性内质网应激。在分子水平上，dFic失调改变了Dop1R1的定位和丰度。最后，我们证明这一调控轴在进化上是保守的，因为FICD的缺失同样减弱了线虫和小鼠的动机行为。总之，这些发现将FICD与动机行为的产生联系起来，并将内质网蛋白质稳态的动态控制与多巴胺受体成熟相关联。

papers.title: Viral dispersal drives changes in population composition
papers.translated_title: 病毒扩散驱动种群组成变化
papers.author: Holmes, K. E.
papers.summary: In an acute viral infection, a small seeding population expands rapidly over several orders of magnitude, then declines. This vast population growth is accompanied by spatial expansion as infection spreads to new anatomical sites within the host. Evolutionary theory predicts that spatially expanding populations experience more extreme stochastic losses of genetic diversity than spatially unstructured populations. To test this prediction in the context of viral dynamics, we evaluated the impact of spatial expansion on viral population genetic structure and assessed how modulators of viral dispersal affected this structure. To this end, we developed a means of implementing the spatial expansion of influenza A virus in cell culture and applied it to a viral population carrying a diverse genetic barcode. Across this simplified cellular landscape, we found that spatial expansion produces a patchwork of distinct viral subpopulations. We then evaluated the consequences for population structure of two modulators of viral dispersal: extracellular viscosity and a common polymorphism in the viral attachment protein. Both physical constraint and viral phenotype altered the extent of genetic bottlenecking and spatial heterogeneity that developed during expansion, indicating that environmental features and viral traits that modulate dispersal also modulate viral population composition, diversity and evolution.
papers.translated_summary: 在急性病毒感染中，一个小的种子种群会在几个数量级上迅速扩增，然后下降。这种庞大的种群增长伴随着空间扩张，因为感染会扩散到宿主体内新的解剖部位。进化理论预测，空间扩张的种群比空间上无结构的种群经历更极端的遗传多样性随机丧失。为了在病毒动力学背景下检验这一预测，我们评估了空间扩张对病毒种群遗传结构的影响，并评估了病毒扩散调节因子如何影响这种结构。为此，我们开发了一种在细胞培养中实现甲型流感病毒空间扩张的方法，并将其应用于携带多样化遗传条形码的病毒种群。在这个简化的细胞景观中，我们发现空间扩张产生了由不同病毒亚群组成的拼凑格局。然后，我们评估了两种病毒扩散调节因子对种群结构的后果：细胞外黏度和病毒附着蛋白中的一种常见多态性。物理限制和病毒表型都改变了扩张过程中形成的遗传瓶颈程度和空间异质性，这表明调节扩散的环境特征和病毒性状也会调节病毒种群组成、多样性和进化。

papers.title: Reversible fixation of microbial cells for targeted genomics
papers.translated_title: 微生物细胞的可逆固定用于靶向基因组学
papers.author: Engelberts, J. P.
papers.summary: Phylogeny- or activity-based fluorescent labelling of microorganisms coupled with fluorescence activated cell sorting (FACS) is a powerful approach to rapidly isolate cells of interest from complex communities for targeted genomics. However, the method has not been widely adopted because standard paraformaldehyde or ethanol fixation procedures hamper nucleic acid recovery and/or long-term sample storage. Here, we present dithiobis(succinimidyl propionate) (DSP) as a reversible fixative for microbial cells that enables fluorescence imaging and DNA extraction and amplification for sequencing. DSP fixation is compatible with widely used fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) approaches and bioorthogonal non-canonical amino acid tagging, and can be applied to diverse sample types, where it consistently performed as well as paraformaldehyde. Furthermore, high-quality genomes were obtained from individual and multiple bacterial cells selectively extracted from complex samples using FISH-FACS. Thus, DSP is a dual-use fixative for microbiome imaging and sequencing, improving targeted microbial genomics.
papers.translated_summary: 基于系统发育或活性的微生物荧光标记结合荧光激活细胞分选（FACS）是一种从复杂群落中快速分离目标细胞进行靶向基因组学的强大方法。然而，由于标准的多聚甲醛或乙醇固定程序妨碍了核酸回收和/或长期样品保存，该方法尚未被广泛采用。在此，我们提出二硫代双（琥珀酰亚胺基丙酸酯）（DSP）作为一种可逆的微生物细胞固定剂，能够实现荧光成像以及用于测序的DNA提取和扩增。DSP固定与广泛使用的荧光原位杂交（FISH）方法及生物正交非经典氨基酸标记兼容，并可应用于多种样品类型，其表现始终与多聚甲醛相当。此外，利用FISH-FACS从复杂样品中选择性提取的单个和多个细菌细胞中获得了高质量基因组。因此，DSP是一种用于微生物组成像和测序的双用途固定剂，改进了靶向微生物基因组学。

papers.title: Birth synchronisation increases allonursing opportunities in free-ranging dogs
papers.translated_title: 出生同步增加了自由放养犬类的异亲哺乳机会
papers.author: Vanderheyden, M.
papers.summary: Over 50 years ago, the hypothesis emerged that co-resident women synchronise menstruation through pheromonal cues. This idea has persisted as a widespread narrative and has subsequently been extrapolated to other animals as well. Indeed, reproductive synchrony has many potential benefits, including creating allonursing opportunities and facilitating female mate choice. Nevertheless, little evidence exists of female vertebrates synchronising their oestrus beyond seasonal effects, through socially mediated cues. We analysed reproductive synchrony in free-ranging dogs, which combine weak, population-dependent reproductive seasonality with facultative cooperative breeding. Controlling for seasonality, we show that birth synchrony was higher among co-resident, maternally related females, suggesting synchronisation among individuals who are likely to cooperate. This was supported by our finding that birth synchrony and maternal kinship independently increased the probability and frequency of allonursing. Finally, preliminary evidence shows that oestrus synchrony decreased male monopolisation. These findings contribute to the debate on socially mediated reproductive synchronisation, suggesting that it may have mainly evolved because it facilitates cooperative breeding.
papers.translated_summary: 50多年前，有人提出假说，认为共同居住的女性通过信息素线索实现月经同步。这一观点作为一种广泛流传的叙事延续至今，并随后被外推到其他动物。确实，繁殖同步有许多潜在益处，包括创造异亲哺乳机会和促进雌性择偶。然而，除了季节性影响之外，几乎没有证据表明雌性脊椎动物会通过社会介导的线索同步其发情。我们分析了自由放养犬的繁殖同步，它们兼具弱的、依赖种群的繁殖季节性和兼性合作繁殖。在控制季节性后，我们发现，在共同居住、母系相关的雌性中，出生同步更高，这表明可能合作的个体之间存在同步。我们的发现支持了这一点：出生同步和母系亲缘关系独立地提高了异亲哺乳的概率和频率。最后，初步证据表明，发情同步降低了雄性垄断。这些发现为关于社会介导繁殖同步的争论作出了贡献，表明它可能主要是因为它促进合作繁殖而进化出来的。

papers.title: Do LLM Proposers Improve Budgeted Search for Ionizable Lipids?
papers.translated_title: LLM提议者是否改善了可电离脂质的预算搜索？
papers.author: Singh, H.
papers.summary: Efficient lipid design under limited experimental budgets is a central challenge in computational chemistry and drug discovery. We introduce LEAF (Lipid Evolutionary Adaptive Framework), a matched-budget protocol for testing whether language-model proposers improve combinatorial molecular search relative to classical baselines. The study uses a 30,044-candidate ionizable-lipid space, a frozen Gaussian-process oracle fitted to experimental potency labels, and a separate active-learning surrogate. Four language models evaluated over eight seeds and three splits show no significant improvement over genetic-algorithm or random-search baselines. For Llama 8B, 79.1% of acquisition-selected queries repeat previously evaluated archive members. Removing duplicates reduces the performance gap on some splits but increases proposal cost and can prevent budget exhaustion. Larger models reduce duplication without establishing superiority or equivalence. Exploratory scored prompts and stricter novelty controls yield positive median differences against the genetic algorithm, yet wide intervals and shared-seed dependence preclude stronger conclusions. A validated single-assay reanalysis preserves the chemotype-cold deficit at a smaller numerical scale, and exploratory expected hypervolume improvement does not reverse the result. Follow-up checks address whether proposers genuinely use injected evidence. These checks include a zero-shot leakage probe, rank-only and chain-of-thought-rationale prompts, a score-shuffle perturbation, an evidence-conflict probe, and a genuine reasoning-mode proposer. They show measurable engagement with supplied information without a corresponding performance gain. LEAF isolates proposal quality as the experimental variable and documents a concrete failure mode of zero-shot LLM proposers under controlled budgets.
papers.translated_summary: 在有限实验预算下进行高效脂质设计是计算化学和药物发现中的核心挑战。我们提出LEAF（脂质进化自适应框架），一种匹配预算协议，用于检验语言模型提议器相对于经典基线是否改善组合分子搜索。该研究使用一个包含30,044个候选物的可电离脂质空间、一个拟合实验效力标签的冻结高斯过程预言机，以及一个独立的主动学习代理模型。四个语言模型在八个随机种子和三种数据划分上评估，相对于遗传算法或随机搜索基线未显示出显著改善。对于Llama 8B，79.1%的采集选择查询重复了先前已评估的档案成员。去除重复可缩小某些划分上的性能差距，但增加提议成本，并可能阻止预算耗尽。更大的模型减少了重复，但未能确立优越性或等价性。探索性评分提示和更严格的新颖性控制相对于遗传算法产生了正的中位数差异，但宽区间和共享种子依赖性阻碍了更强的结论。一项经过验证的单测定再分析在较小的数值尺度上保留了化学型冷启动缺陷，而探索性期望超体积改进并未逆转该结果。后续检查探讨提议器是否真正使用了注入的证据。这些检查包括零样本泄漏探测、仅排名和思维链理由提示、分数打乱扰动、证据冲突探测，以及一个真正的推理模式提议器。它们显示出对提供信息的可测量参与，但没有相应的性能增益。LEAF将提议质量作为实验变量隔离出来，并记录了零样本LLM提议器在受控预算下的一个具体失败模式。

papers.title: BioMod: Biological Module Tokenization for Single-Cell Foundation Modeling
papers.translated_title: BioMod：用于单细胞基础建模的生物学模块标记化
papers.author: Meng, L.
papers.summary: Single-cell foundation models typically represent cells as flat sequences of individual genes, requiring higher-order biological organization to be inferred implicitly from sparse expression profiles. Similar to the evolution from character-level to semantic tokenization in natural language processing,we hypothesize that cellular states can be more efficiently represented using biologically meaningful intermediate units. Here we present BioMod, a 50-million-parameter single-cell foundation model that introduces biological modules as representation units between genes and cells. BioMod constructs an overlapping vocabulary of 660 biological modules derived from curated pathways and data-driven gene programs, replacing thousands of gene-level inputs with compact module representations. Pretrained on approximately 73 million human cells using high-ratio module masking with an asymmetric decoder, BioMod achieves state-of-the-art performance across cell-type annotation, zero-shot batch integration, perturbation-response prediction and drug-response forecasting while maintaining a compact architecture that enables efficient inference on a single GPU. Module-level analyses further demonstrate that BioMod captures biologically meaningful cellular programs and preserves pathway-level organization.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞基础模型通常将细胞表示为单个基因的扁平序列，需要从稀疏表达谱中隐式推断更高阶的生物组织。类似于自然语言处理中从字符级到语义标记化的演变，我们假设细胞状态可以用具有生物学意义的中间单元更高效地表示。在此，我们提出BioMod，一个拥有5000万参数的单细胞基础模型，引入生物模块作为基因与细胞之间的表示单元。BioMod构建了一个包含660个生物模块的重叠词汇表，这些模块来源于精选通路和数据驱动的基因程序，用紧凑的模块表示替代了数千个基因级输入。BioMod在约7300万个人类细胞上预训练，采用高比例模块掩码和非对称解码器，在细胞类型注释、零样本批次整合、扰动响应预测和药物响应预测方面达到了最先进的性能，同时保持紧凑的架构，可在单块GPU上高效推理。模块级分析进一步表明，BioMod能够捕获具有生物学意义的细胞程序并保留通路级组织。

papers.title: HERO: A hierarchy-aware analysis pipeline for reducing and refining whole-brain atlas-mapped cellular datasets
papers.translated_title: HERO：一种用于减少和精炼全脑图谱映射细胞数据集的层级感知分析流程
papers.author: Shipman, A. L.
papers.summary: Advances in high-throughput mesoscale microscopy and machine learning-based image analysis pipelines have made unbiased whole-brain imaging widely accessible. However, translating the resulting atlas-mapped datasets into biologically meaningful results remains a substantial barrier owing to their sheer magnitude and complex hierarchical organization. Consequently, reporting structure and analysis methods vary widely across studies, undermining rigor and reproducibility. To address this, we developed a user-friendly data reduction workflow, HERO (Hierarchy-aware Expression Region Organization), designed to perform hierarchy-aware selection, refinement, ranking, and visualization of whole-brain cell detection datasets. The workflow is customizable to specific needs, requires minimal coding experience, and outputs transparent, curated results. HERO functions as a seamless plug-in within larger-scale whole-brain cell detection analysis pipelines, providing efficient, unbiased region selection to streamline subsequent statistical analyses and comparative evaluations. Although HERO is developed with mouse cell-detection datasets, it can be applied to any atlas-mapped dataset that contains hierarchical information. Here, we applied the HERO pipeline to example cell detection datasets containing afferent cells from the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BST) and the insular cortex (insula). HERO provided top projecting regions consistent with historical tracing studies for the BST (e.g., amygdalar and hypothalamic regions) and the insula (e.g., somatosensory, autonomic, and interoceptive regions). Furthermore, the refinement step of HERO provides additional enriched regions originally obscured in the primary ranked outputs, such as memory- and emotion-associated structures. With HEROs dynamic processing, we were able to identify top-projecting regions consistent with the literature and, additionally, find regions often obscured in these large datasets. In sum, HERO offers a standardized analysis workflow to reduce whole-brain cell-detection datasets, transforming raw regional cell counts into curated results and advancing the effectiveness, interpretability, and accessibility of whole-brain imaging in neuroscience.
papers.translated_summary: 高通量介观显微成像和基于机器学习的图像分析流程的进展，使无偏全脑成像得以广泛普及。然而，由于数据规模庞大且具有复杂的层级组织，将由此获得并映射到脑图谱的数据集转化为具有生物学意义的结果仍然存在重大障碍。因此，不同研究报告的结构和分析方法差异很大，削弱了严谨性和可重复性。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种用户友好的数据降维工作流程HERO（层级感知表达区域组织），旨在对全脑细胞检测数据集进行层级感知的选择、精炼、排序和可视化。该工作流程可根据具体需求进行定制，所需编程经验极少，并能输出透明、经过整理的结果。HERO可作为更大规模全脑细胞检测分析流程中的无缝插件，提供高效、无偏的区域选择，以简化后续统计分析和比较评估。尽管HERO是针对小鼠细胞检测数据集开发的，但它可应用于任何包含层级信息的脑图谱映射数据集。在此，我们将HERO流程应用于示例细胞检测数据集，这些数据集包含来自终纹床核（BST）和岛叶皮层（insula）的传入细胞。HERO提供的顶级投射区域与BST（如杏仁核和下丘脑区域）和insula（如躯体感觉、自主和内感受区域）的历史示踪研究一致。此外，HERO的精炼步骤还提供了最初在主要排序输出中被掩盖的额外富集区域，例如与记忆和情绪相关的结构。通过HERO的动态处理，我们能够识别与文献一致的顶级投射区域，并额外发现这些大型数据集中常被掩盖的区域。总之，HERO提供了一种标准化分析流程，用于对全脑细胞检测数据集进行降维，将原始区域细胞计数转化为经过整理的结果，并提升神经科学中全脑成像的有效性、可解释性和可及性。

papers.title: Criticality-related dynamics accompany long-term functional decline in primary cortical MEA cultures
papers.translated_title: 关键性相关动力学伴随原代皮层MEA培养物的长期功能衰退
papers.author: Escobar, A.
papers.summary: Primary cortical neuron cultures are widely used to study network development and decline, but their long-term electrophysiological trajectories are poorly characterized. We used multi-electrode arrays to longitudinally monitor Wistar rat cortical cultures for up to ~730 days in vitro (DIV), combining activity measures with survival analysis and criticality metrics. Wells shared an early developmental phase, with mean firing rate peaking at 12-14 Hz around DIV 100-150, before diverging into two phenotypes: early-death wells, showing progressive loss of burst organization, longer inter-burst intervals, shorter bursts, and steep declines in active-electrode recruitment; and long-survival wells, which sustained organized bursting and measurable activity well beyond DIV 400, in some cases past DIV 700. Cox proportional-hazards modeling with FDR correction across thirteen candidate features identified burst duration, inter-burst interval, synchrony, mean firing rate, branching ratio, and Kappa index as significant predictors of time to network failure. Criticality metrics offered the most mechanistic insight: in early-death wells, branching ratio declined toward zero and Kappa index rose toward its upper bound as networks approached silencing. Beyond their average levels, the rate of change of branching ratio and Kappa index over recordings was the strongest correlate of survival time among all criticality metrics. Neuronal avalanche size and duration exponents and their scaling relation, remained consistent with scale-free dynamics in both phenotypes while networks were active, though avalanche occurrence rate declined progressively in early-death wells without reaching significance as an independent predictor. These results show that long-term network survival is not determined by firing rate alone, but by preserved burst organization, sustained electrode recruitment and near-critical propagation dynamics. This work offers one of the longest electrophysiological characterizations of rodent cortical cultures to date and identifies criticality-based metrics as promising tools for predicting network decline and evaluating interventions to preserve long-term neuronal function.
papers.translated_summary: 原代皮层神经元培养被广泛用于研究网络发育与衰退，但其长期电生理轨迹仍缺乏充分表征。我们使用多电极阵列对Wistar大鼠皮层培养物进行纵向监测，时间长达体外约730天（DIV），并将活动指标与生存分析和临界性指标相结合。各孔共享一个早期发育阶段，平均放电率在DIV 100–150左右达到峰值12–14 Hz，随后分化为两种表型：早期死亡孔，表现为爆发组织进行性丧失、爆发间期延长、爆发持续时间缩短以及活跃电极募集急剧下降；长期存活孔，则维持有组织的爆发和可测量活动远超DIV 400，部分甚至超过DIV 700。采用Cox比例风险模型并对十三项候选特征进行FDR校正后，发现爆发持续时间、爆发间期、同步性、平均放电率、分支比和Kappa指数是网络失效时间的显著预测因子。临界性指标提供了最具机制性的洞见：在早期死亡孔中，随着网络接近沉默，分支比降至趋近于零，而Kappa指数升至趋近其上限。除平均水平外，分支比和Kappa指数随记录的变化率是所有临界性指标中与生存时间相关性最强的指标。神经元雪崩大小和持续时间指数及其标度关系，在网络活跃期间与两种表型中的无标度动力学均保持一致，尽管早期死亡孔中雪崩发生率逐步下降，但作为独立预测因子未达到显著性。这些结果表明，长期网络存活并非仅由放电率决定，而是由保留的爆发组织、持续电极募集和接近临界的传播动力学决定。这项工作提供了迄今为止对啮齿动物皮层培养物最长的电生理表征之一，并确定基于临界性的指标是预测网络衰退和评估干预措施以维持长期神经元功能的有前景工具。

papers.title: Deciphering auditory neuroprogenitor stemness for large-scale neuronal screening
papers.translated_title: 解析听觉神经祖细胞的干性以实现大规模神经元筛选
papers.author: Rousset, F.
papers.summary: Sensorineural hearing loss can arise from damage to sensory hair cells, auditory neurons or their synaptic connections, with auditory neuropathy and cochlear synaptopathy highlighting the importance of neural integrity for hearing. The mammalian cochlea has limited capacity to regenerate lost auditory neurons. Understanding the molecular programs that sustain cochlear progenitor expansion and neurogenic competence could support neuronal regeneration and provide renewable models for auditory drug discovery. We previously established that WNT activation combined with dual SMAD inhibition (CHIR-DS) supports scalable expansion and neuronal differentiation of mouse auditory neuroprogenitors (ANPGs). Here, we characterize the transcriptional, chromatin and metabolic changes associated with the induced state. RNA-seq and ATAC-seq identified reduced Id1 and Id2 expression and increased accessibility at proneural basic helix-loop-helix motifs, alongside transcriptional enrichment of translation, mTOR and glucose-metabolism programs. Compared with growth-factor controls, CHIR-DS-treated ANPGs showed slight increase in glycolysis at early passage. However, after long-term expansion, both glycolysis and mitochondrial respiration were markedly enhanced. Human fetal ANPGs also responded to CHIR-DS with increased sphere growth and retained neural differentiation capacity, providing proof of concept beyond the mouse system. Finally, neurons derived from stemness-induced ANPGs (siANs) supported a 384-well reporter assay and a 2,560-compound pilot screen that nominated candidate neurite-outgrowth enhancers. Together, these findings validate the pathway basis of ANPG stemness induction, characterize the resulting molecular and metabolic state, and demonstrate human feasibility and a neuronal screening application.
papers.translated_summary: 感音神经性听力损失可由感觉毛细胞、听觉神经元或其突触连接的损伤引起，其中听觉神经病和耳蜗突触病凸显了神经完整性对听力的重要性。哺乳动物耳蜗再生丢失听觉神经元的能力有限。理解维持耳蜗祖细胞扩增和神经发生能力的分子程序，可支持神经元再生，并为听觉药物发现提供可再生的模型。我们此前已确定，WNT激活联合双重SMAD抑制（CHIR-DS）可支持小鼠听觉神经祖细胞（ANPGs）的可规模化扩增和神经元分化。在此，我们表征了与诱导状态相关的转录、染色质和代谢变化。RNA-seq和ATAC-seq发现Id1和Id2表达降低，前神经碱性螺旋-环-螺旋基序处可及性增加，同时翻译、mTOR和葡萄糖代谢程序的转录富集。与生长因子对照相比，CHIR-DS处理的ANPGs在早期传代时糖酵解略有增加。然而，在长期扩增后，糖酵解和线粒体呼吸均显著增强。人胎儿ANPGs也对CHIR-DS作出反应，表现为球体生长增加并保留神经分化能力，提供了超越小鼠系统的概念验证。最后，源自干性诱导ANPGs（siANs）的神经元支持384孔报告基因 assay 和2,560化合物初步筛选，提名了候选神经突生长增强剂。总之，这些发现验证了ANPG干性诱导的通路基础，表征了由此产生的分子和代谢状态，并展示了人类可行性和神经元筛选应用。

papers.title: A foundation model for brain organoid network dynamics uncovers intrinsic computation and convergent disease phenotypes
papers.translated_title: 脑类器官网络动力学的基座模型揭示了内在计算与汇聚性疾病表型
papers.author: Schweiger, H. E.
papers.summary: Brain organoids develop self-organizing neural networks that can be used to model neurodevelopment and disease. Here we introduce PULSE, a foundation model developed using over 900 hours of high-density microelectrode array recordings of in vitro and ex vivo neural tissue. We show that this single model can address two open questions: how disease-associated variants alter network development, and how naive circuits encode information. PULSE revealed accelerated network maturation in held-out human 16p11.2-deletion organoids. It also revealed a change in network coordination shared with SHANK3 deficiency. Because organoids develop without sensory input, they let us ask how circuits encode information before any representation is learned. Closed-loop control of a virtual inverted pendulum engaged existing spontaneous activity patterns rather than creating new ones. PULSE provides a common reference frame for neural circuits across genotypes, protocols and tasks.
papers.translated_summary: 脑类器官可发育形成自组织神经网络，可用于模拟神经发育和疾病。在此，我们介绍PULSE，这是一个利用超过900小时的高密度微电极阵列记录体外和离体神经组织所开发的基础模型。我们表明，这一单一模型可以解决两个未决问题：疾病相关变异如何改变网络发育，以及初始回路如何编码信息。PULSE揭示了留出的人16p11.2缺失类器官中网络成熟加速。它还揭示了与SHANK3缺陷共有的网络协调变化。由于类器官在没有感觉输入的情况下发育，它们使我们能够探究回路在任何表征被学习之前如何编码信息。对虚拟倒立摆的闭环控制调用了已有的自发活动模式，而不是创造新的模式。PULSE为跨基因型、方案和任务的神经回路提供了一个共同的参考框架。
